name: css_animation_transition
description: DIFF-TRIGGERED `animation` TRANSITIONS, OLD-TREE-GOVERNS (USER ruling 2026-08-17). Mount 1 declares `animation: all 1s linear` on #sidebar; mount 2 changes width 200px -> 40px AND DROPS the `animation` declaration - the transition must still run (the OLD cascade owned the animation), driven by a per-tick user-override on the one engine clock. Frame 0 must still measure 200px (a transition never flashes its target), the linear midpoint must measure ~120px (proving the per-tick incremental-relayout escalation actually re-solves layout), and the override must dissolve at t=1 leaving the cascaded 40px. Mount 3 then RE-ADDS `animation` while changing the width back - the old tree (mount 2) had no `animation`, so the change must SNAP with zero transitions: the reverse direction never retro-animates.
